title: GYFT
text: GYFT (Get Your Freakin' Timetable) is a CLI tool and a web app, which allows users to fetch their class schedule from ERP as an ICS file, and add it to their calendar applications.

chunks.text:
GYFT

GYFT (Get Your Freakin' Timetable) is a CLI tool and a web app, which allows users to fetch their class schedule from ERP as an ICS file, and add it to their calendar applications.
